<thought>The monoisotopic mass of the base peak (m/z 182.073165) matches the calculated mass for C₁₃H₁₀O (13 × 12.0000 + 10 × 1.007825 + 15.994915 = 182.073165). The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 14 % and M+2 ≈ 1 %) is consistent with ~13 carbons (13 × 1.1 % ≈ 14 %) and a single oxygen atom, confirming the formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H10O</final_answer>
